Review Title: Unforgettable views, Orcas, San Juan Island
Review Text: It was a beautiful clear day and we were able to see so many things! Views of downtown Seattle and the sky line, Puget Sound, San Juan Islands. On the way to Friday Harbour we saw 3-4 Orcas. The cascade mountain range and the Olympic mountain range were beautiful against the blue sky! Captain was great explaining different sites and pointing out lighthouses below. On our way back flew near Washington stadium where a game was going to be played later. An unforgettable experience.

Review Text:

Review Title: Terrible company cancelled with no notice
Review Text: The seaplane company called the night before and cancelled the trip for my son and me. They said they were overbooked but we had booked weeks before. Also i asked why they had left it until the night before to call surely they knew they were overbooked long before. My son and i had only 1 day in Seattle and were extremely disappointed. We are still waiting on our $700 refund from Tripadvisor . This is a terrible way to treat people.
